title: Master page has Terminal, History and Messages tabs and never scrolls the page document
description: A real browser against the served dashboard with a stub herdr master pane (with >=500 lines of scrollback), 300 seeded typed-input history lines and cross-install messages: Terminal is selected by default showing only the status line and terminal; History and Messages are tabs in a keyboard-navigable tablist kept in the URL hash (Messages hidden when empty); reload and shared links open the same tab; at 1280x800 and 390x844 on every tab document scrollHeight equals clientHeight and scrollWidth equals clientWidth; wheel scrolling the terminal moves only the terminal while window.scrollY stays 0, and wheel scrolling History scrolls inside its panel while window.scrollY stays 0.

steps.name: Verify Master page tabs, URL persistence, keyboard navigation and zero document scroll at 1280x800 and 390x844
